title: Clover
tagline: Messaging and collective file storage for members of DAOs. Exchange important messages and files.
description:
Clover enables DAOs to store files collectively while allowing them to chat. 
We use Covalent, IPFS and Tableland on the project, to enable token-gating and storage, alongside Spheron for deployments.
Built on the Polygon Blockchain.
The process involves authentication and logging on to registered DAOs if any. 
If none, you could create a new DAO and enter the addresses of DAO members. 
Once this is done, the dashboard loads up where you can view the collective DAO directory, and the chat modal.
